verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is a card-issuing API platform, not an AI agent or assistant host that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply. The llms.txt probe concerns documentation for AI readers, not consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
